description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance Curfew Commence from 09.05.2022 from 19.00 hours to 11.05.2022 until 7.00 hours
reasoning: This gazette content is a Curfew Order issued under Section 16 of the Public Security Ordinance. It establishes a legal/regulatory framework by imposing restrictions on public movement in specified areas during a designated time period. The content involves the exercise of statutory powers to create legally binding regulations for public order and safety, which falls squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) concerning regulatory frameworks and legal notices.
